peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.statement: Price position — In line with comparable condos: 4.8% below its local comparables; 31 of 85 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Above peers (79.3): 4.7 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 208 of 266 similar developments with a figure (the same as 6). Context, not scored: resales in 45.8% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments

missing.reason: too few resales by bedroom type for a like-for-like entry-price comparison

lines.statement: Not available: too few resales by bedroom type for a like-for-like entry-price comparison; the size-matched price position applies.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Marine Terrace MRT about 360 m, Marine Parade MRT about 520 m; closer than 372 of 462 similar developments (the same as 4). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 3 within 1 km and 7 within 2 km; nearest CHIJ (Katong) Primary about 340 m; more than 340 of 462 similar developments (the same as 68). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 4 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 430 m), more than 288 of 462 similar developments (the same as 94); nearest hawker centre Marine Terrace about 610 m; nearest park Marine Parade Rd Park about 480 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 8 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (K Suites, 6 new sales, about 550 m; Straits at Joo Chiat, 3 new sales, about 710 m; Claydence, 8 new sales, about 740 m; Koon Seng House, 6 new sales, about 860 m; Verdé Joo Chiat, 9 new sales, about 1,160 m; Ardor Residence, 13 new sales, about 1,430 m; Amber House, 31 new sales, about 1,520 m; Emerald of Katong, 2 new sales, about 1,610 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 398 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 297 new sales and 910 resales (1,207 purchases); new sales were 24.6% of these purchases. Subsales (19) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: No site within 2 km in the known list. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 910 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 400 of 462 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 910 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 971 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−6.3%). Planning-area private resales −7.9%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
